_comment: Sound design map for the Fuzzlings animatic. 'at' = seconds on the 120 s timeline, 'gain' = dB applied at mix time, 'dur' = requested length from the ElevenLabs sound-effects API. Prompts are deliberately wordless: creature vocalisations are gibberish, no language.

cues.name: amb_park
cues.prompt: quiet eerie abandoned amusement park night ambience, soft wind, distant metal rattle, faint insect chirps, no music, no voices

cues.name: bzzt_neon
cues.prompt: old broken neon sign buzzing and flickering to life, electric bzzt crackle, short

cues.name: ffshh_hatch
cues.prompt: pressurized spaceship hatch opening, sharp air release hiss FFSHH, then soft metallic clank

cues.name: pirr_curious
cues.prompt: tiny cute alien creature curious chirping purr, pirr pirr, sniffing a rubbery surface, cartoon, gibberish, no words

cues.name: viip_warning
cues.prompt: retro sci-fi radar dish spinning with two-tone warning beeps, viip viip viip, small servo whine

cues.name: floinng_first
cues.prompt: huge cartoon trampoline boing, springy metallic FLOINNG, comedic

cues.name: hwop_yelp
cues.prompt: small cartoon creature surprised yelp HWOP, gibberish alien squeak, no words

cues.name: land_thud
cues.prompt: soft body landing thud on a trampoline mat followed by a small second bounce, cartoon

cues.name: pip_victory
cues.prompt: hyperactive tiny alien creature excited chirps pip pip pip, happy cartoon squeaks, gibberish, no words

cues.name: hihihi_bix
cues.prompt: mischievous small furry creature giggling, hihihi cartoon chuckle, gibberish, no words

cues.name: ping_scanner
cues.prompt: slow retro sonar scanner pings, piiip ... piiip, soft electronic sweep

cues.name: floinng_duo
cues.prompt: two springy cartoon trampoline boings in a row, comedic floing floing

cues.name: wooah_panic
cues.prompt: cartoon creature panicked falling yell WOOOAH, alien gibberish, no words

cues.name: floinng_chain
cues.prompt: escalating series of cartoon trampoline boings speeding up, floing floing FLOING, rhythmic comedic crescendo

cues.name: whoosh_spin
cues.prompt: fast cartoon spin whoosh through the air, swoosh with light doppler

cues.name: bonk_launch
cues.prompt: comedic cartoon collision bonk launching two bodies away, rubbery boing tail

cues.name: krrrik_wheel
cues.prompt: giant rusty metal ferris wheel starting to rotate, long creaking groan KRRRIK, heavy bearings squeal

cues.name: slowmo_arc
cues.prompt: slow motion dramatic airy whoosh with low rumble and rising shimmer, no music

cues.name: bum_bum_bum
cues.prompt: three soft body thuds landing one on top of the other in quick succession, cartoon bum bum bum

cues.name: beep_boop
cues.prompt: retro spaceship console waking up, beep beep boop, small relay clicks and power-up hum

cues.name: vrrrr_motor
cues.prompt: small electric servo motor whirring as a sci-fi door slides shut, VRRRR, ending with a soft clunk

cues.name: gulp_trio
cues.prompt: three tiny alien creatures making a worried uh-oh gulp squeak together, gibberish, no words

cues.name: pop_final
cues.prompt: short comedic cartoon POP, bright bubble pop, single hit

cues.name: logo_sparkle
cues.prompt: short bright magical sparkle shimmer sting, playful, no music melody
